title: Plugin Catalog Entry
description: One plugin as authored in plugins/<id>.json: what it is, where it is released and the versions that are yanked. scripts/build-catalog.mjs adds the releases from the GitHub Releases of repository_url to build the catalog entry that the catalog schema of nginxui/plugin-spec describes.

author_public_key.description: Minisign public key (text form) that signs plugin.sums in the packages of a community entry. Required when trust is "community".

screenshots.description: Images of the plugin in use, in display order. PNG, JPEG or WebP, about 16:10 at 1280 to 1920 pixels wide.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the plugin's own source (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, AGPL-3.0-only).

yanked.description: Versions that are withdrawn. The catalog keeps them marked yanked and hosts no longer offer them.

pluginId.description: Reverse-DNS style id. com.nginxui.* is reserved for official plugins; authors without a domain use io.github.<owner>.<name>.

locale.description: BCP-47-ish locale key as used by nginx-ui's gettext catalogs, e.g. "en", "zh_CN", "zh_TW", "ja_JP".

localizedText.description: Locale code to translated string. "en" is required as the fallback nginx-ui always falls back to.

dark_url.description: The same view in the dark theme, at the size of url. Hosts show url when it is absent.

trust.description: Trust level the entry claims. official: published by the nginx-ui project. verified: published by a partner organization the maintainers vouch for, with a partner certificate in the package or a listing in the partner keyring (v1/partners.json), with no claim about source review. community: signed by the author with author_public_key. The host derives the effective level from the key that signed plugin.sums inside the package.

semver.description: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0, matching internal/plugin.semverPattern in nginx-ui.
